description: This file defines the TalkModeController class, which manages the state and behavior of the talk mode feature in the application. It includes methods to enable/disable talk mode, update phases and levels, pause/resume, and stop talking, integrating with various other components via shared instances and asynchronous tasks.

classes.name: TalkModeController
classes.description: A singleton class managing the talk mode state, user interactions, and communication with other system components to sync the UI and backend states.

methods.name: setEnabled(_ enabled: Bool)
methods.description: Enables or disables talk mode, updates UI overlays, and manages associated runtime and wake listener states.

methods.name: updatePhase(_ phase: TalkModePhase)
methods.description: Updates the current talk mode phase, updates the overlay UI, and communicates the change to the backend.

methods.name: updateLevel(_ level: Double)
methods.description: Updates the visual level indicator in the overlay.

methods.name: setPaused(_ paused: Bool)
methods.description: Pauses or resumes the talk mode, updating UI, backend, and wake listener states accordingly.

methods.name: togglePaused()
methods.description: Toggles the paused state of talk mode.

methods.name: stopSpeaking(reason: TalkStopReason)
methods.description: Stops speaking in talk mode, providing a reason for stopping.

methods.name: exitTalkMode()
methods.description: Disables talk mode and updates the shared state.
